svg.title: Moztoba Mutashim Billah
svg.desc: Moztoba Mutashim Billah, Master of Business Analytics, Sunway University. Projects built with public data, from the raw files to a dashboard or a web app. Open to data analyst and business analyst roles. In the animation a copy of the CV flies to a Data Analyst job card and then to a Business Analyst job card, and each is marked Applied.

g.text: MASTER OF BUSINESS ANALYTICS · SUNWAY UNIVERSITY
I build projects with public data, from the raw files
to a dashboard or a web app people can use.
